notes.title: New demo update - Basic shooting lesson
notes.notes:
Hello friends!
I created a new training scenario for learning the basics of handling weapons.
You will find it in the training campaign.
Fixed a bug with missing sound pulses for Katerina. 
Sound pulses are a very important UI element, so I created a version of this effect for low graphics settings.
I look forward to your feedback. 
Subscribe to my social networks to stay up to date with news and updates.

Thank you for playing!
[previewyoutube=00gr4vY9REA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog: Weapon selection menu update
notes.notes:
Hello friends! 
I have improved the quick access menu. I have added the following functionality:
[olist]
 Display of attachments installed on weapons
 Switching between primary weapons and sidearms.
 Switching between throwables
[/olist]

I would be very glad to receive your feedback!
[previewyoutube=xu0M1EE0WZo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Release of the demo version
notes.notes:
Hello friends! 
I am very excited that the demo version of my game is available for download. I hope you like it. I really need feedback, so I ask you, if possible, to participate in the discussion. I really need your support and feedback for further development of the game.

Thank you very much!
